entity_noun: certification, accreditation, registration, standard, or compliance

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it, without tripping any of the guards below:

rules.text: The record says something substantive about the candidate {{entity_noun}} — describing an activity, arrangement, or dealing that involves it — rather than only naming it, listing it, or mentioning it in passing. Which party is involved is not this condition's subject; [SCR-2] decides that.

children.text: A {{entity_noun}} displayed, listed, or published as the holder's own — a certificate bearing a name, a certificate number, an issuing body, a document offered for viewing or download — is concrete evidence of {{entity_relationships.gerund}} it, not a mere mention in passing.

rules.text: It is the manufacturer itself that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} the candidate {{entity_noun}} — not a customer, supplier, distributor, or other third party that the manufacturer merely relates to.

children.text: Records refer to the manufacturer in question only as "the manufacturer" or "[the manufacturer]", never by name; other companies may appear by name or by their standing. A brand, trade name, former name, division, plant, or business unit of the manufacturer IS the manufacturer itself. A statement about the manufacturer's parent company or a sister brand counts as one about the manufacturer itself, and does not fail this condition merely for being attributed to them — unless the record shows the activity belongs to that company alone and not to the manufacturer.

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} is ruled out if ANY of these guards is violated by it. Ruling out one candidate has no bearing on the record's other candidates:

rules.text: The manufacturer's involvement in the candidate {{entity_noun}} is only aspirational, hoped-for, planned, in-progress, or discontinued, rather than current and actual.
